svg.title: IDEA Server Module authority
svg.desc: Scoped administrators call only their owning Modules. Identity and Accounts establishes actor context, Project Governance supplies membership facts to Access Policy, and Access Policy returns immutable authorization decisions. Artifact Custody owns bytes and locations while Controlled Product Data owns only Artifact References. A narrow use-case coordinator opens a shared relational unit of work for a named operation; it does not own state or generic CRUD authority.
